title: Savory Baked Oatmeal with Eggs & Spinach
description: A soft, cheesy baked oatmeal that works for breakfast or an easy supper.
substitutions: Use frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry.

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and grease an 8-inch baking dish.
Whisk milk, eggs, salt, and pepper. Stir in oats, chopped spinach, and 1/2 cup cheese.
Pour into the dish, top with remaining 1/4 cup cheese, and bake 28–30 minutes until the center is set.

cookSteps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and grease an 8-inch baking dish.
Whisk 2 cups milk, 3 eggs, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper. Stir in 2 cups oats, 2 cups chopped spinach, and 1/2 cup cheese.
Pour into the dish, top with the remaining 1/4 cup cheese, and bake 28–30 minutes until the center is set.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days. Reheat slices in the microwave.

title: Cheesy Egg-in-a-Hole Toast
description: Crisp buttered toast with a soft egg cooked right in the middle.

steps.text: Cut a 2- to 3-inch hole from the center of the bread.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add bread and the cutout.
Crack the egg into the hole, season, and cook 2–3 minutes. Flip and cook 1–2 minutes more; add cheese near the end if using.

cookSteps.text: Cut a 2- to 3-inch hole from 1 slice of bread.
Melt 1 teaspoon butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add the bread and the cutout.
Crack 1 egg into the hole, season with a pinch of salt and black pepper, and cook 2–3 minutes.
Flip carefully and cook 1–2 minutes more. Add 2 tablespoons cheese during the last minute if using.

title: Vegetable Cheddar Frittata
description: A simple skillet-baked egg dish that uses up stray vegetables.
substitutions: Use mozzarella, Swiss, or pepper jack instead of cheddar.

steps.text: Cook vegetables in oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat for 5–7 minutes until just tender.
Whisk eggs, milk, and salt. Pour over vegetables, sprinkle with cheese, and bake 12–15 minutes until just set.

cookSteps.text: Cook 1 1/2 cups chopped vegetables in 1 tablespoon oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat for 5–7 minutes until just tender.
Whisk 6 eggs with 1/4 cup milk and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Pour over the vegetables and sprinkle with 3/4 cup cheese.
Bake 12–15 minutes until the center is just set.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days. Good warm or cold.

title: Tomato Rice & Bean Skillet
description: A filling pantry skillet with rice, tomatoes, beans, and warm spices.
substitutions: Use pinto beans or kidney beans.
Use canned tomatoes with green chiles for more heat.

steps.text: Combine rice, tomatoes, beans, water or broth, chili powder, and cumin in a large skillet.
Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low, and cook 18 minutes.
Turn off heat and rest covered 5 minutes. Fluff and top with cheese if using.

cookSteps.text: Combine 1 cup rice, 1 can diced tomatoes, 1 can black beans, 1 1/2 cups water or broth, 1 teaspoon chili powder, and 1/2 teaspoon cumin in a large skillet.
Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low, and cook 18 minutes.
Turn off heat and rest covered 5 minutes. Fluff and top with 1/2 cup cheese if using.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 2 months.
